snippet.title: HoN: Reborn Open Beta Announcement
snippet.description:
Heroes of Newerth: Reborn Open Beta will be LIVE November 11th, 2025.  It will be free to play for everyone to join!
_______________________________________________________

Website: https://heroesofnewerth.com/
Discord (EN): https://discord.com/invite/kongor (Project Kongor)
Discord (TH): https://discord.gg/honth (Project Kongor)
Play Project Kongor HoN Now: https://projectkongor.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/heroesofnewerth/
X: https://x.com/heroesofnewerth
Support HoN Reborn: https://app.juvio.com/g/HON

Music in Video:
"Firestorm" by Cold Cinema
Link: http://bit.ly/3kguPTZ


_______________________________________________________

#HeroesofNewerth
#HoN
